notes.text:
An update is available for openssl.
This update affects Rocky Linux 9.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
OpenSSL is a toolkit that implements the Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) and Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocols, as well as a full-strength general-purpose cryptography library.

Security Fix(es):

* openssl: openssl: Denial of Service via excessive memory allocation in CRL distribution point processing (CVE-2026-35189)

* openssl: openssl: Denial of Service via excessive QUIC packet buffer retention (CVE-2026-54873)

* openssl: openssl: Denial of Service via crafted CMP certificate revocation response (CVE-2026-75805)

* openssl: openssl: Denial of Service via inefficient QUIC stream reassembly (CVE-2026-42772)

* openssl: OpenSSL: Private key recovery via timing side-channel in generic elliptic curve operations (CVE-2026-54872)

* openssl: OpenSSL: Denial of Service via unenforced QUIC connection flow control (CVE-2026-75804)

* openssl: openssl: information disclosure via non-constant-time SM2 scalar multiplication on ARM64 and RISC-V (CVE-2026-54875)

* openssl: openssl: Traffic amplification Denial of Service via QUIC packet over-accounting (CVE-2026-35191)

* openssl: OpenSSL: Private key recovery via SM2 timing side-channel (CVE-2026-77696)

* openssl: openssl: Denial of Service via out-of-bounds write during TLS context switch (CVE-2026-72897)

* openssl: OpenSSL: Denial of Service via undersized DTLS record (CVE-2026-75806)

* openssl: OpenSSL: Denial of Service via unbounded QUIC connection identifier backlog (CVE-2026-84784)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* [Rocky Linux 9.9] OpenSSL silently uses default provider when `fips.so` is missing on systems in FIPS mode (JIRA:Rocky Linux-239862)

* OpenSSL fails to initialize when automatic initialization happens in threads [Rocky Linux 9] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-256385)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
